title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：volunteer　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 volunteer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the warden ① thanked the volunteer that no resident in the centre would have recorded, and he said the thanking was the whole of the month. The ② volunteer, meaning the helper itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a volunteer, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ volunteer in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ volunteer at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A volunteer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the warden said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the volunteer was the whole of the matter, meaning the devotion and not the helper. The ⑥ volunteer, meaning the devotion and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; volunteer, he said, is either something you thank or the only word that means both a helper and a devotion. He said the devotion is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ volunteer had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ volunteer of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of recording; volunteer, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ volunteer I remember is the helper recorded in the register, which closed in 1973 and is still recorded as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ volunteer, my mother said in 1975, is the only helper that improves by being recorded; every volunteer, she said, is a devotion that has agreed to look like a helper. She said the devotion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 志愿者（指社区中心里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 志愿者（指那位志愿者本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：thank the volunteer 谢这一位志愿者
D. n. 志愿者（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 志愿者之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的志愿者之事）
F. n. 志愿者（指登记册里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 志愿者、热忱（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 热忱（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: thanked the volunteer that no resident in the centre would have recorded

the volunteer at the far gate

answers.why: thank the volunteer 意为“谢这一位志愿者”，1966 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记载的一位志愿者做了一遍。
volunteer 意为“志愿者”，指那位志愿者本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
volunteer 意为“志愿者”，指社区中心里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
volunteer 意为“志愿者”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
volunteer 意为“志愿者、热忱”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位热忱就是那件事的全部。
volunteer 意为“热忱”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位志愿者，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
volunteer 意为“志愿者”，指登记册里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1971 年这一位成了登记册里的一行。
volunteer 意为“志愿者之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的志愿者之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记载。
volunteer 意为“志愿者”，我记得的是登记册里记载过的那一位，1973 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一位。
volunteer 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，志愿者是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的志愿者。
